title: Deliver a clicker clear of the active projection

robot_resolution.note: Primary installed library robot model available.

assets.genie_license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (AgiBot Genie Sim Assets; local meshes/textures kept private, videos & metrics public)

verification_methodology.disclosure: Conference room with an active ceiling projector casting a 3D volumetric frustum onto the front projection screen (`benchmark_whiteboard_000` with printed presentation slide) as the presenter (`Female_Adult_03`) begins speaking to two attendees (`Male_Adult_02`, `Male_Adult_12`). Fetch carries a presentation clicker (`benchmark_barcode_scanner_000`) on its tray. Projected occlusion is scored directly by sampling ray intersections from the projector lens to a 12x8 screen grid against live Fetch MuJoCo meshes (zero fabricated forces).
